description: This file defines the class KmsMaterialsProviderV2, which implements methods for using AWS KMS to provide encryption materials, including generating data keys and decrypting ciphertexts, specifically tailored for use with the AWS SDK's encryption clients.

classes.name: KmsMaterialsProviderV2
classes.description: Provides AWS KMS encryption material handling, including key generation and decryption, for encrypted data operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the KmsMaterialsProviderV2 with a given KmsClient and optional KMS key ID.

methods.name: getWrapAlgorithmName
methods.description: Returns the algorithm name used for key wrapping, which is 'kms+context'.

methods.name: decryptCek
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted content encryption key (CEK) using KMS, considering options and context.

methods.name: generateCek
methods.description: Generates a new Data Encryption Key (DEK) using KMS, with specified key size and encryption context.
